units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:17">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> <he>במלכי או״ה משיב שְׁאִילַת שלום</he> as regards gentile kings, you may answer the greeting (during prayer).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:3:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>איגרות של רשות זו ש׳ שלום</he> “letters of a secular character” (ib. III, 3), that means, social correspondence.
<cite ref="Makkot 23b">Macc. 23ᵇ</cite> (<he>בשם</he>) <he>וש׳ שלום</he> and using the name of the Lord in salutation.

<cite ref="Shevuot 32a">Shebu. 32ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כדי שאילת תלמיד לרב</he> as much time as is required for the disciple to salute the teacher <he>(שלום עליך רבי</he>); <he>כדי ש׳ הרב לתלמיד</he> as is required for the teacher to salute the pupil <he>(שלום עליך</he>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 95b:6">B. Mets. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיהו בעלים משעת ש׳ עד וכ׳</he> (the borrower is responsible,) unless the owner is present from the moment of lending the animal to that of the accident.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 95b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ בבעלים</he> borrowing an object together with employing its owner for service.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 98a:8">Ib. 98ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>שאילה</he> (interch. with <cite ref="U00033"><he>שַׁאֲלָה</he></cite> or <cite ref="U00033"><he>שְׁאֵלָה</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="U01156"><he>שְׂכִירוּת</he></cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="U00025"><he>שְׁאֵילָה</he></cite>.
